note: KIT RANGES (3 Nov), from the kit's sample code, untested on this arm: for the first powered session only (needs.md C7). scripts/first_moves.py explores inside them (at most 45 degrees from home by default) and proposes measured ranges in calib/arm_limits_proposed.json. Must match firmware/mimic_arm/arm_logic.h (a unit test checks). Real moves need placeholder false AND limits_checked_by_hand true. Pins (2 Nov) are from the kit's sample code, untested on this arm. GRIP (4 Nov, Girik): a LOWER angle closes this claw; open (and where the 5 s relaxation returns it) is 90. grip_closed_limit_deg is the one setting for the direction (below open = lower closes). It is PROVISIONAL at 20: the empty jaws do not touch anywhere down to 40, and below 40 is not checked yet; if they touch at 20 or above, raise it to the touching angle plus 2, in both files. The grip is only ever sent from the closed limit to 140; grip_range_deg 10-140 is the servo's whole range. grip_hold_deg (what 'grip close' uses) is unknown until scripts/grip_test.py.
